name: blender-kiln (Claude Code plugin: photo or text to Blender model)
summary: Open-source Claude Code plugin that builds real-size, editable 3D models in Blender from a text brief or a photo: sourcing, scripted modelling, cleanup, CC0 scan texturing, optimization and validation. Exports GLB, FBX, USDZ or STL with Draco/WebP compression; default path is Claude scripting Blender via an MCP server, no GPU or AI model needed. Logs the licence of every source it pulls (Poly Haven, Sketchfab, optional generators).

access.price: $0 (needs Claude Code and Blender; model usage billed by your Claude plan)
access.notes: Plugin is MIT. Optional generators carry their own terms (e.g. UniMate checkpoints CC BY-NC, Hunyuan3D not licensed in EU/UK/KR); README documents them and kiln asks before using them.

procedure: Install Blender and a Blender MCP server (mcp-for-blender or official Blender Lab MCP).
In Claude Code: /plugin marketplace add elithril/blender-kiln
Run /kiln setup to detect Blender, the MCP server and optional tools (gltf-transform recommended).
Ask: /kiln <object description> or give it a photo.

verdict.why: Well-documented agent workflow for Blender with careful per-source licence tracking; 163 stars, v3.0 release, MIT verified; source post 283 likes/409 bookmarks. Requires a paid Claude plan to actually use.
